## Feature checklist (development directive)
- [ ] Business requirements: what problem this solves (link the PRD requirement IDs)
- [ ] Technical design: approach, and any ADR created or updated
- [ ] Database changes: migrations listed, reviewed, reversible; none applied to any deployed environment
- [ ] Security controls: authz, tenant isolation, input validation, logging/redaction considered
- [ ] Automated tests: unit / property / integration as appropriate
- [ ] Edge cases tested: list them
- [ ] Sample data: synthetic fixtures added or updated (no real data)
- [ ] User-facing validation: error messages are actionable
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Known limitations listed below
